title: fix(app-shell): the flow designer names a schedule flow "Schedule", not "Schedule (cron)"
body:
Fixes #12845
Clause-②: no

## What changes
The flow designer's Start node Trigger option for the `schedule` kind read "Schedule (cron)", so an interval or once schedule flow (the stock showcase's `showcase_scheduled_digest`, `{ type: 'interval', intervalMs: 60000 }`) was labelled a cron in the Trigger select, the flow header's Trigger pill and the New automation trigger picker. The option now reads **"Schedule"** (zh 「定时」), whatever cadence the flow stores. The cadence stays the Cron schedule field's to show (objectui#12779).

- `flow-node-config.ts`: `{ value: 'schedule', label: 'Schedule' }`. The `value` and every field gating are unchanged.
- `metadata-admin/i18n.ts` (`FLOW_FIELD_ZH.start.triggerType.opts.schedule`): 「定时」, the word the same catalogue already uses for the flow-level `schedule` type in `FLOW_META_ZH`.

## Measurements
- **A1, one label source (confirmed).** The header pill's `flowTriggerLabel` in `FlowPreview.tsx` reads the option label from `localizeFlowFields('start', fieldsForNodeType('start'), locale)`, the same option list the inspector's select renders and the New automation picker lists. No literal copy in the pill, so it is not edited.
- **Packs.** The label lives only in the designer catalogue (en `flow-node-config.ts` + zh `metadata-admin/i18n.ts`). `git grep` for `Schedule (cron)` and for the zh wording over the tree hits nothing in `packages/i18n`; no language-pack key carries it, so only those two moved (the triage comment's "all ten packs" has no pack to move).
- **A2, pins.** The three named pin files move to "Schedule". New pins: an interval schedule flow reads "Schedule" (and not `/cron/i`) in the Trigger select (`FlowNodeInspector.timeRelativeStart-12672.test.tsx`) and in the header pill (`StudioDesignSurface.flowStatusTruth-11779.test.tsx`, a `scheduled_digest` fixture flow); the cron flow beside each reads the same label.
- **Ablation** (fix committed first, mutation through `ablation-replace.mjs` with a trap restore): putting back `label: 'Schedule (cron)'` turned 5 tests red across the two files, including both new interval pins (`Tests 5 failed | 22 passed (27)`). Restore proven: blob after restore == HEAD blob `ac686da851`, `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Gates (at `64443ba182`; patch round at `41a7ba5ab8`: targeted vitest 160/160, closure build, type-check, `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:control-bytes`, `check-changeset-presence`, narrowed eslint, each exit 0)
- Targeted vitest (the 3 pin files + both 12779 files): `Test Files 5 passed (5)`, `Tests 160 passed (160)`.
- Narrowed app-shell run: every app-shell test file that mentions `Schedule`, `triggerType` or 定时 (54 files): `Tests 944 passed (944)`. The whole `packages/app-shell/` directory did not finish inside the foreground cap on a shared box (stopped after 72 min at one worker; the `inspectors/` directory alone timed out at 590s); declared to CI.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (after the closure build `--filter '@object-ui/app-shell^...'`): exit 0.
- eslint narrowed to the 5 changed `.ts/.tsx` files (`--no-inline-config`): 5 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. The config enables no type-aware linting, so the diff cannot move any untouched file's verdict.
- Pre-tsc battery: all exit 0 except `check:spec-floors` (exit 1, `no-artifact`: it needs a full workspace build; recorded, not fixed). `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-presence`: exit 0.

## Acceptance notes
- The same option's `help` said "schedule triggers fire on a cron" (zh 「定时触发按 cron 触发」), and the comment above the `start` group said scheduled starts use a cron `schedule`. Folded in at the seat's request in `41a7ba5ab8`: both now name the three cadences (a cron, an interval or a set time). Help ablation: putting back `fire on a cron.` turns the interval pin red (`Tests 1 failed | 17 passed (18)`); restored blob == HEAD `230fb1e40f`.
